title: Channelmight
summary: Channelmight is a spell used to revitalize unconscious Titans and give them a new surge of energy. Though similar to Newlife, Channelmight is used on Titans who have lost consciousness without returning to their Amulets whereas Newlife is used on Titans who have returned to their Amulets.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This spell was used by [[Mallory]] to revive an unconscious [[Pellinore]] in order for him to charge at and defeat [[Caliban]]. {{source|Cave of the Casterwills}}

full_text:
Channelmight is a spell used to revitalize unconscious Titans and give them a new surge of energy. Though similar to Newlife, Channelmight is used on Titans who have lost consciousness without returning to their Amulets whereas Newlife is used on Titans who have returned to their Amulets.

== History ==
This spell was used by Mallory to revive an unconscious Pellinore in order for him to charge at and defeat Caliban. [Cave of the Casterwills]
